rules.sentence: Rigidity is most commonly associated with basal ganglia injuries.
Catatonia is a neuropsychiatric disorder in which patients demonstrate abnormal posturing.
Increased muscle tone in catatonia depends on the force applied to the affected muscle.
Human recombinant hyaluronidase has emerged as a promising therapeutic option for treating spasticity.
In individuals with spasticity, elevated hyaluronan concentrations are associated with increased tissue viscosity and reduced muscle pliability, limiting both passive and active range of motion.
This accumulation interferes with normal muscle contraction and fiber extensibility, exacerbating functional impairment.
Human recombinant hyaluronidase enzymatically hydrolyzes hyaluronan, reducing the GAG's concentration and mitigating the associated decrease in tissue stiffness.
